prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” agency — the right one depends on what you need (brand creative, digital performance, B2B, local retail, industry experience, budget, timeline, etc.). 

If you want a quick starting point:
- VML (VMLY&R) — Kansas City–based global agency; strong at large-brand strategy, integrated creative, and digital/tech-enabled campaigns.
- Barkley — another major KC creative agency known for bold brand work and integrated marketing for national clients.

How I can help next:
- Tell me the business/industry, what marketing services you need (SEO, PPC, social, creative, branding, B2B sales enablement, etc.), your budget and timeline — I’ll recommend 3–5 Kansas City agencies (large, mid-size, and boutique) that suit your needs and explain why.
